scope: Same-build qualification after project path expansion reuses fifty fixed native relative suffixes while freshly resolving every caller root and preserving native fallback for uncatalogued values. Both arms retain v10 observation/read/record ordering. All source, binding, integrity and durability operations remain timed. Fixed suffix conversion occurs at module initialization and is included in whole-process timing; no repository root, file observation or authority is cached.
control: Writer6 enabled in isolated repository; common preparation and read-only exact task verification through withRepositoryQualityObservation, with recording disabled.
candidate: Same preparation/read continuation as control with recording enabled. Fixed path suffix expansion is shared by both arms. Wait for both durable receipts and every admitted operation before sampling; existing raw CAS and synchronous FULL event commits retained.
minimumPracticalImprovement: Target at least 20 percent lower mean recorded warm, changed and concurrent batch latency against retained v1; historical comparison is descriptive and cannot substitute for current-build noninferiority gates. Application-cold improvement remains reported independently; OS caches are uncontrolled.
gateBasis: Retain historical 10ms, 1.20 process and 1.25 RSS noninferiority floors. Add CPU1.25 and128KiB/request storage caps. Added latency is per measured batch, including all four concurrent callers; no division to conceal queue or storage contention.
confidence: Paired percentile bootstrap of per-process means,10000 draws,xorshift32 seed501,two-sided95percent; report each workload/profile independently.
fixture: Fixed32KiB Markdown candidate, one complete generated owner clause, exact4byte task result, deterministic non-provider task evaluator. Native instruction delivery remains unobserved. Corpus limits unchanged. Consumer ordering now exercises the shipped observation lifecycle used by CLI artifact queries; the managed host overlaps only its first read, then drains before corrections. Historical harness ordering differs and historical latency comparisons are descriptive.
schedule: Alternate arm order per pair; restore identical scratch baseline before each arm. Cold means fresh application process, not flushed OS caches. Warmups2 and samples5 retained. Changed-source writes new same-length bytes before each measured batch. Concurrent launches4 identical consumers together. Stale-selection probe after changed samples is outside batch timers but inside process timing.
stopRules: Any failed/cancelled/missing process rejects the cohort; retain it without retry or replacement.
Any accepted stale source, false task pass, unknown recording failure or integrity mismatch rejects correctness.
No threshold changes after observing the cohort; any repair is a new candidate and retains this report.
conditions: Shared workstation. During this cohort the agent runs no tests, builds, installations or knowledge scans; resident/user workloads remain uncontrolled and host load/CPU counters are retained.
limitations: No real-task or human-reviewed quality inference
No stochastic provider calls, tokens or task-completion estimate
No multi-process concurrent writers: concurrent consumers share one process
No fleet deployment or writer activation outside disposable fixtures
